messages:
Taylor Reed: Quick kickoff for SparrowPilot onboarding. Short thread to assign owners, confirm success criteria, and lock the 30-day plan.

Taylor Reed: Draft success criteria:
- Staging integration + automated smoke tests passing
- Demo p95 latency < 300ms under 500rps demo load
- Two enablement sessions recorded and uploaded
- Baseline metrics captured for renewal story (tokens, latency, support volume)

Akira Sato: I'll own staging integration and the sample requests. ETA Day 4 for first endpoint.

Mina Park: Security lead here. I'll send pen-test scope and retention policy. Need their SOC contact and any special data residency requirements.

Julian Ortiz: CS ops will build the 30/60 checklist and add a finance checkpoint Day 11. Also will create a short CSAT form for post-demo feedback.

OnboardBot: Calendar event created: "SparrowPilot Onboarding - Weekly" Mon Jun 8 11:00 PDT. Invitees: Taylor, Akira, Mina, Julian.

Akira Sato: Sample curl for staging (temp token):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.sparrow.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer stg_sparrow_42" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"hello"}'
```

Akira Sato: Response includes latency_ms + request_id. Will hook metrics to their dashboard.

Mina Park: Risk: SOC review could delay demo if pen-test scope not agreed by Day 9. Also flag PO process for burst capacity.

Julian Ortiz: Action items:
- Akira: staging endpoint + curl (Due Day 4)
- Mina: pen-test scope + retention doc (Due Day 5)
- Taylor: baseline metric capture plan (Due Day 2)
- Julian: playbook + finance checkpoint Day 11 (Done)

Taylor Reed: Pilot plan: Redwood runs controlled 1hr replay Day 15, customer runs extended test Day 17-18. Confirm owners for traffic profile.

Akira Sato: I'll own traffic profile and run the replay with them.

FinanceBot: Reminder: customer billing requires PO for monthly spend > $8k. Add finance touchpoint before scale tests.

Taylor Reed: Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm your items so I can lock dates.

Akira Sato: :thumbsup:

Mina Park: :thumbsup:

Julian Ortiz: :thumbsup:
